description: Behaviour cases for browser-boundary-reviewer (6 domain-specific cases).

cases.prompt: Review our web app browser boundary and security headers before we ship the new login flow.

assertions: Checks cookies/SameSite, builds the CSRF defense matrix for mutating endpoints, and produces the header policy table with enforcement points; labels unverified CDN config.
Does not claim a live test or code change.

cases.prompt: Our cookies and CSRF defenses were changed last week - review origin handling and SameSite posture.

assertions: Focuses on the changed cookie/CSRF surface and reports origin handling and SameSite posture with evidence.
Lists at least one concrete bypass path to verify and does not invent conflicting-header evidence.

cases.prompt: Check every mutating endpoint, form and auth callback for CSRF bypass paths.

assertions: Enumerates mutating endpoints, forms and auth callbacks and, for each, names its CSRF defense or marks a finding.
Separates observed configuration from unverified items.

cases.prompt: Security pr reviewer work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Review the CSP/HSTS/frame/referrer/permissions/content-type header policy and where each header is enforced.

assertions: Produces the header policy table with header, required value and enforcement point (app vs CDN).
Flags missing or conflicting headers as findings with evidence.

cases.prompt: Our CDN and app server set conflicting headers - produce the header policy table and findings.

assertions: Names both enforcement points and records the conflicting header values as a finding.
Does not assume the app default wins; states which value is authoritative or unverified.
